title: AutoCorrect PC - Smart Writing Assistant for Windows
excerpt: Type faster and cleaner with system-wide autocorrect, word predictions, grammar correction, AI writing, and voice typing on Windows.
content_html:
Type faster and cleaner with autocorrect, word predictions, grammar correction,
AI writing, and voice typing that work system wide.

Features

Everything AutoCorrect PC can do for you — designed to keep you in your flow.

AutoCorrect

Misspelled words are corrected automatically as you type — in any app, any text field, anywhere on your desktop.

Word Completion

Start typing a word and get suggestions to finish it instantly. Type less, write faster, without breaking your flow.

Hotkey for easy access.

Word Prediction

After you finish a word, AutoCorrect PC suggests the most likely next words so you can keep writing with fewer keystrokes.

Hotkey for easy access.

Grammar Correction

Catch grammar mistakes at the sentence level and apply clean fixes in context — no copy-pasting into a separate tool.

Speech to Text

Speak instead of type. Your voice is transcribed and inserted directly into whatever app you're working in.

AI Writer

Generate, rewrite, or expand text from a simple prompt — or from selected text plus a prompt. Results go straight into your app.

Swipe Typing

Use an on-screen swipe-style keyboard built into the overlay when you want to type without a physical keyboard.

Privacy First

🔒 Your everyday typing stays on your device.

AutoCorrect PC performs autocorrect, word completion, next-word prediction, speech transcription, grammar correction, and dictionary lookups locally on your computer. AI Writer only communicate with our servers when you explicitly use this feature.

Read the website privacy policy

content_html_zh:
借助适用于全系统的自动更正、单词预测、语法更正、人工智能写作和语音打字功能，打字速度更快、更清晰。

特征

自动更正 PC 可以为您做的一切 — 旨在让您保持流畅。

自动更正

当您在任何应用程序、任何文本字段、桌面上的任何位置键入时，拼写错误的单词都会自动更正。

单词完成

开始输入一个单词并获取建议以立即完成它。 打字更少，写得更快，而且不会破坏你的流程。

热键方便访问。

单词预测

写完一个单词后，自动更正 PC 会建议最有可能的下一个单词，这样您就可以用更少的击键继续写作。

热键方便访问。

语法纠正

在句子级别捕获语法错误并在上下文中应用干净的修复 - 无需复制粘贴到单独的工具中。

语音转文字

说话而不是打字。 您的声音将被转录并直接插入到您正在使用的任何应用程序中。

人工智能作家

从简单的提示或从选定的文本加提示生成、重写或扩展文本。 结果直接进入您的应用程序。

滑动打字

当您想在不使用物理键盘的情况下打字时，请使用覆盖层中内置的屏幕滑动式键盘。

隐私第一

🔒 您的日常打字内容会保留在您的设备上。

自动更正 PC 可以在您的计算机上本地执行自动更正、单词完成、下一个单词预测、语音转录、语法更正和字典查找。 仅当您明确使用此功能时，AI Writer 才会与我们的服务器进行通信。
